comment: Packages whose licence is outside the allowed list but is accepted, each with a reason. Owner: verifier. The coordinator must confirm the LGPL entry (RULES section 4 allows LGPL only as an unmodified, separate, replaceable file).

packages.name: @img/sharp-libvips-*
packages.reason: Prebuilt libvips shared library pulled in by sharp, which Astro uses at BUILD time for image optimisation in apps/site (a static site). It is never bundled into shipped JS, the extension, the CLI or the MCP server, is loaded as a separate unmodified native file, and nothing from it is in apps/site/dist. Remove it from the closure by setting the Astro image service to 'noop' or dropping sharp.

packages.name: argparse
packages.reason: PSF-style permissive licence (attribution only). Transitive dependency of js-yaml used by Astro at build time; not part of any shipped bundle.
